header.running_head: Leading the Salaah and Following the Imaam During the Time of Rasulullaah ﷺ

blocks.text: Hadhrat Furaat bin Hayyaan (RA) Performs Salaah in his Masjid behind Hadhrat Handhala bin Rabee (RA) on the Instruction of Rasulullaah ﷺ

Hadhrat Qais bin Zuhayr (RA) says, "I once walked with Handhala bin Rabee (RA) to the Masjid of Furaat bin Hayyaan (RA). When the time for salaah arrived, Hadhrat Furaat (RA) told Hadhrat Handhala (RA) to go forward (to lead the salaah). Hadhrat Handhala (RA) refused saying, "I cannot lead you in salaah when you are elder than me and have migrated before me. In addition to this, it is your Masjid. Hadhrat Furaat (RA) however said, "I have heard Rasulullaah ﷺ say something about you because of which I can never lead you in salaah." "So were you also present during the Battle of Taa'if when Rasulullaah ﷺ sent me as a spy?" Hadhrat Handhala (RA) asked. When Hadhrat Furaat (RA) confirmed that he was present, Hadhrat Handhala (RA) stepped forward and led the salaah.

(When the salaah was over) Hadhrat Furaat (RA) (turned to the people and) said, "O tribe of Ijal! I have made him lead the salaah because Rasulullaah ﷺ once sent him to Taa'if as a spy and when he reported back, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to him, 'Your information is correct. You may return to your camp because you have been awake all night.' As he turned and left, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to us, 'Always follow him and the likes of him.'" [^2]
The Ameer of Makkah Appoints Hadhrat Ibn Abzah as his Deputy to Lead the salaah To the Approval of Hadhrat Umar (RA)

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abu Layla (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Abu Layla (RA) narrates that when he once accompanied Hadhrat Umar (RA) to Makkah, they were received by the Hadhrat Naafi bin Alqama (RA) who was the Ameer of Makkah. "Who have you appointed as your deputy over the people?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) asked. "Abdur Rahmaan bin Abzah (RA)," came the reply. Hadhrat Umar (RA) said, "You chose a man from amongst the slaves over members of the Quraysh and the Sahabah (RA) of Rasulullaah ﷺ?" "That I have done," Hadhrat Naafi (RA) replied, "because I found him to be the most proficient reciter of the Qur'aan and because Makkah is a place where people from all parts gather, I wanted them to listen to Allaah's Book from a person who recited well." "Your judgement is excellent," Hadhrat Umar (RA) commended, "Abdur Rahmaan bin Abzah (RA) is certainly amongst the people whom Allaah has elevated through the
